ai.title: Microsoft is openly competing with OpenAI, Anthropic more than ever
ai.brief: Microsoft is in a unique position as AI overtakes the tech industry. It’s one of the world’s largest cloud providers and software-as-a-service companies, while also holding valuable stakes in the two biggest AI labs , OpenAI and Anthropic. Those incentives are starting to clash as Microsoft posts blockbuster financial results. 8 billion. 7 billion for the year. And CEO Satya Nadella is not about to let the trajectory of Anthropic and OpenAI — which are expanding into applications and agentic infrastructure that could ultimately let them own customer relationships — derail that kind of cash. Nadella has been preaching to enterprises to use multiple models and to stop relying on the frontier AI labs for the agentic harness/app layer.

sec.title: eSIM Plus and Nicegram Share Belarus-Linked Codebase, Analysis Finds
sec.brief: S. CISA adds Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator and Fortinet FortiOS flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog Two popular apps available in EU app stores, Nicegram, with over 50 million downloads, and eSIM Plus, with over 1 million, are presented to users as Lithuanian products. The Mysterium VPN Research Team pulled apart both Android packages to see what the binaries themselves reveal, following OCCRP reporting that both apps are allegedly developed and controlled from Belarus. What they found in the code substantially corroborates that reporting. ” reads the report published by Mysterium VPN Research Team. ”
